decisions.reason: The multi-model line sits in the firm's core safety-shoe business with sunk tooling and range investment, so management persists even though the website only mentions it.
Having already dropped the comfort insole, the firm keeps the supportive insole as part of its tailored foot-measurement offering, but its low visibility leaves it the most exposed.
The ergonomic series has its own page and several models, embodying the announced innovation direction, so public commitment and invested resources argue for continuing it.
As the home-page flagship of the firm's direction, the moulded insole carries the strongest public commitment and need for justification, so any weak results would be attributed to temporary causes.
